seo.summary: Week 1 is the foundation phase of the Q3 plan: get the technical + schema + AI-crawler groundwork in place so every later content and programmatic push compounds. No new blog pages this week by design — comparison content starts Week 3.

items.what: Verified JobPosting schema is live on every /jobs/[slug] and added BreadcrumbList to job pages
items.why: You already rank #1 in Google's AI/SGE block for "[city] webflow developer" — JobPosting keeps you eligible for the Google Jobs rich result, and breadcrumbs add a second rich-result type + clearer crawl structure.

items.what: Added FAQPage schema to resource articles that contain an FAQ section (auto-parsed from the content)
items.why: FAQ rich results expand your SERP footprint, and LLMs preferentially extract clean Q&A pairs — this directly feeds AI citations for salary/hiring questions.

items.what: Added BreadcrumbList schema across resource articles
items.why: Breadcrumb rich results + a clearer hierarchy for crawlers and answer engines.

items.what: Published /llms.txt with your citable salary + hiring data and key pages
items.why: Gives ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini an explicit, structured map to find and cite Webflow Jobs salary data — the core of the GEO strategy.

items.what: Updated robots to explicitly welcome AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot, etc.) and blocked /admin + /api
items.why: Ensures eligibility for AI-engine citations (your AI presence is currently just 1–2) while keeping private routes out of the index.

items.what: Expanded SE Ranking rank tracking from 10 → 60 keywords
items.why: We can now measure the page-2→page-1 pushes (webflow developers #22, webflow developer #27) and the quick-win targets (webflow vs framer, webflow alternative, webflow agency) week over week.

items.what: Built an automated weekly metrics query + this report pipeline
items.why: So every Monday you get the same numbers and SEO progress without asking.

prevWeekResultsNote: Week 1 is the baseline — there's no prior week to compare yet.
